observations: The plan's step 8 (a bogus escalate kind through the pane returns the daemon's 400) is unreachable as written: the plugin's zod schema (tools.ts:64) and tools.ts:171 refuse the kind before any request, and the daemon checks the capability (issues.ts:230) before the kind (issues.ts:231). The daemon's 400 for a bogus kind is reachable only over HTTP because validateContractRequest runs before auth (api.ts:237); recorded that way in the PR body.

The root architect on this rig is a headless omp --mode rpc pane behind legion worker-shim, not a TUI, so tmux send-keys (plan step 6) is not an input path; the prompt was delivered as an RPC prompt frame over the architect's shim socket with the daemon's own connectWorkerRpc client, and appears in the transcript as an ordinary user message.

OMP in --mode rpc does not answer negotiate_protocol/get_state while a turn is streaming and answers immediately once idle; this is the daemon's 'failed to connect ... shim socket on ready' line (already tracked as LEGION-39; evidence posted there as a comment). Waiting for idle before the restart is what made the batch the first capability-bearing action.

The rig's daemon does not log HTTP requests, so the single /worker-session recovery on the head run is proven by the unit tests, not the rig; the rig proves the user-observable outcome (both calls succeed) under the same conditions that produced the 403 on the parent build.
The workspace carries an untracked .omp/config.yml that predates this phase; left alone.
